test_title: SSC MTS (2022) Official Paper (Held On: 04 May 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Six boys Ram, Sumit, Sunil, Rahul, Raj and Aman are sitting around a circular table facing towards the centre (not necessarily in the same order). Sunil is not the immediate neighbour of Aman. Aman is second to right of Ram. Rahul is second to the right of Sumit. Raj is to immediate left of Ram. Who is second to the right of Rahul?
solution:
Given: Six boys Ram, Sumit, Sunil, Rahul, Raj and Aman.

1) Raj is to immediate left of Ram.

2) Aman is second to right of Ram.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ce43806e9363580c5607ffef7d89b62eb9dd04c078284fc6e4264e1481f81407.png] 

3) Rahul is second to the right of Sumit.

4) Sunil is not the immediate neighbour of Aman.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/766bb7d2ade6aaffd0064684940600a55ea1f316233b3d7ec6f7e958fb490015.png] 

Here, '**Raj**' is second to the right of '**Rahul**'.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 3"**.
